name: ACE Banjo Diff. Major Kit
applications: Fitment evidence (Dana Spicer exact-part listing; SADC2149KDC): the supplier identifies this as an “Ace-Banjo-Diff Major Kit” for “ACE 0.75 T” / “TATA ACE .75T”. This confirms the Tata Ace 0.75-ton Banjo axle application, not every Ace axle or 1-ton/Salisbury variant. Match axle type and tonnage before supply. Sources: https://www.danaaftermarket.in/pd-481_spicer-ace-banjo-diff-major-kit-sadc2149kdc ; https://www.anandgroupindia.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/Drive-Shaft-Axle-Spares-List-for-ACE-Model.pdf
description: The Spicer SADC2149KDC ACE Banjo Diff. Major Kit serves the differential or final-drive assembly, which distributes torque between the driven wheels while allowing them to rotate at different speeds. Vehicle applications include Tata Ace.

name: ACE Banjo 39/8
applications: Fitment evidence (Dana Spicer exact-part listing and Spicer/Ace axle matrix; SACW2149B398): identified as “Ace CWP Banjo-39/8”, with 39 crown-wheel teeth, 8 pinion teeth and 4.875 ratio; Dana lists Tata Ace Pickup / Tata Ace Magic, and the axle matrix specifies Ace HT Pickup/Magic Banjo configurations. Confirm Banjo axle type and 39/8 ratio before ordering; do not generalise to every Ace axle or Salisbury configuration. Sources: https://www.danaaftermarket.in/pd-355_spicer-ace-cwp-banjo-39-8-sacw2149b398 ; https://www.anandgroupindia.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/Drive-Shaft-Axle-Spares-List-for-ACE-Model.pdf
description: The Spicer SACW2149B398 ACE Banjo 39/8 transfers drive into the differential and redirects torque through the axle gear assembly. Vehicle applications include Tata Ace.

name: Timing Belt
applications: Vehicle fitment evidence (Souviks Tata commercial-vehicle brochure; exact part-number match): Tata 407, Tata 709 and Tata 1109.

Independent catalogue cross-check: public supplier listings for Tata part 254705116312 also report Winger School and Ace 275/EX/HT/Magic HT applications (Vikings Automobile; exact part-number listing). This conflicts with the Souviks brochure's 407/709/1109 mapping; confirm by VIN/Tata eCATS before promoting either list as exclusive.

Independent Tata parts-catalogue cross-check (P14 / Indigo-Dicor parts catalogue, Engine Timing Parts, exact part 254705116312): listed as a Gates GD100 timing belt, “Chassis Type: ALL” within the Indigo-Dicor catalogue. The Souviks current application note separately cites Tata commercial-vehicle brochure evidence for 407/709/1109. These sources identify different vehicle contexts; do not use the P14 Indigo-Dicor entry to expand truck fitment or to discard the separate commercial-vehicle evidence without exact engine/OE validation. Confirm belt tooth count, profile, length, engine family and pack marking. Source: https://www.tatamotor.com.pl/file/catalogues-p14-indigo-dicor.pdf
description: The Tata Genuine Parts 254705116312 Timing Belt transmits rotation from the driving pulley to connected engine accessories; ribbed or Poly-V designs use multiple longitudinal ribs to engage matching pulleys. Vehicle applications include Tata 407, Tata 709 and Tata 1109.

name: Taper Roller Bearing 30204
applications: Vehicle fitment evidence (Souviks Tata commercial-vehicle brochure; exact part-number match): Tata 1109, 1210, 1312 and 1512.

Bearing-source reconciliation (Delta Bearing Co. Tata application table, exact standard bearing designation 30204; Tata Genuine OE reference 269533403101): Delta lists 30204 for Tata Ace front-wheel inner position and Tata 1512 water-pump application. The Souviks record is a 30204 taper-roller bearing and the exact OE number is independently identified as a Tata taper-roller bearing, but the catalogue currently tags Tata 1109, 1210, 1312 and 1512. This source supports only its stated Ace/1512 uses; it does not substantiate every current model tag. Match the bearing designation, cup/cone set, position and physical dimensions to the axle/pump before supply. Sources: https://www.deltabearing.com/application/21/bearings-for-tata.html ; https://www.bpautosparesindia.com/oem-detail/TA164DLX/
description: The Tata Genuine Parts 269533403101 Taper Roller Bearing 30204 uses tapered rollers and matching raceways to support combined radial and axial loads in rotating assemblies. Vehicle applications include Tata 1109, Tata 1210 and Tata 1312.

name: Vibrosonic Horn
applications: Manufacturer family application reference (Roots Automotives, Vibrosonic horn family): Roots lists Vibrosonic horns for trucks and documents 24 V within the family voltage range. This is consistent with a 24 V truck-horn use for the product family, but the public page does not independently certify the exact vehicle models Tata LPT, Tata Signa or Ashok Leyland 2516 for stock code 24V/VSU024H. Verify the stamped model, current draw, connector, relay and mounting before supply. Sources: https://www.rootsautomotives.com/ ; https://www.rootsautomotives.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/02/ELECTRIC-HORNS-AUTOMOTIVE-PRODUCTS.pdf
description: The Roots 24V/VSU024H Vibrosonic Horn produces an audible warning signal for use in the vehicle’s sound-warning circuit. The stated electrical rating is 24 V. Vehicle applications include Tata LPT, Tata Signa and Ashok Leyland 2516.
